pause_preservation.problem_confirmed: IL-2 4.09m returns a simulation-timed emitter to a small initial state after leaving the pause menu, then visibly replays its age for about five seconds.
pause_preservation.scope: Little Boy and Fat Man particle actors registered by the merged Explosions class
pause_preservation.detection: one shared real-time MsgAction watcher every 25 ms while a registered emitter remains valid
pause_preservation.control: cached reflective call to the protected native Eff3D.pause(boolean) method
pause_preservation.failure_mode: fail open with one log message; conventional effects and the pause menu are not patched
pause_preservation.runtime_verdict: failed: the plume still restarts after pause/resume and after leaving then re-entering the camera field; the watcher must not be considered a validated fix

intentional_engine_adaptations: The stock IL-2 inverse-square TNT falloff is restored instead of granting full nuclear power everywhere inside the radius.
The 2 psi historical planning radius becomes the bounded engine-damage radius after airburst geometry and cube-root yield scaling.
The 1 psi and 0.5 psi outer knots and the aircraft velocity coupling are documented gameplay approximations, not historical source values.
Wave delay samples actor distance at detonation; impulse direction uses the actor position at arrival, but moving-target interception is not continuously recomputed.
Thermal flash is visual in this iteration; thermal burns and ionizing radiation are not simulated.
No crater is spawned for the historical airbursts.
The legacy bomb50_land nuclear follow-up is removed only from the nuclear branch.
The primary cloud uses ten minutes of simulated formation and up to one hour of simulated visibility; pausing must consume neither interval.
